info.name: Matomo Reporting API for plugin Tag Manager API
info.description: Exposes the Tag Manager API for managing containers, versions, tags, triggers, and variables. The endpoints also provide installation metadata, publishing workflows, preview controls, and import/export operations. A container may have several versions, and the current editable version is exposed as the "draft" version by {@link TagManager.getContainer}.
